master.description: Waterproof GPS fitness monitor accurately records and displays your time, distance, and heart rate while you swim (or run) to help you attain your fitness goals.
master.features: Water-resistant construction meets IPX7 standards Includes the standard wrist strap and 2 fabric replacement straps that fit a variety of wrist sizes Optional heart rate monitor strap (sold separately) lets you track heart rate for optimal performance; add the strap and gain access to 5 customizable heart rate zones
master.name: Aqua Force GPS Fitness Monitor
master.reviews:
By NE2WA from Edmonds, WA
This watch/gps/heart rate monitor is a data crunching gem. With the free online connection, you can actually watch a graphical display of your swim/run on a map with associated changes in your heart rate, pace and step rate (with the foot chip). It takes a little time to set up, but is simple to use once you get started. I am loving this device and the feedback it's giving me.
